correctness.rationale: The replacement credits the earlier complete polynomial identity and specializes it at −1: the logarithmic derivative is the power sum of the six reciprocal-factor roots, which produces the integer recurrence. Independently reconstructed a six-state run automaton: a doubled column has two empty neighbors and each same-layer singleton run has length at most two. A valid indexed cyclic word has exactly one based run walk (when there are only singletons, not all are equal), so its trace gives the enumerator. Its characteristic polynomial equals the reported nonzero factor; traces for all n≥3 uniquely determine the nonzero spectrum, by Vandermonde on distinct nonzero roots. Independent forbidden-vertex-triple enumeration matched whole polynomials for n=3..6. Recomputed all signed values 3..19 and the exact rational brackets and error certificate at n=20 (error ratio <2/3); monotone decay makes the latter uniform. Euler–Poincaré gives the repaired homology lower bound and noncontractibility. Replay: python /workspace/reproduce_frozen.py 3. Only the explicit case checks are finite; the run bijection and sign argument justify all n.
